author_code_exact_gradient.gradient: One gradient of total scalar to all trainable weights. With feature sharing, peer paths remain differentiable.
author_code_exact_gradient.loss: Batch mean of sum_owner CE + beta*sum_nonowner KL plus weight decay; no division byM.
author_code_exact_gradient.ownership: K lowest scores CE_m+beta*sum_other KL; same ordering as CE_m-beta*KL_m; selected indices form a discrete mask.

author_feature_sharing.ResNet_test_behavior: Inspected ResNet calls feature_sharing whenever flagTrue with no is_train branch; mask function has no phase switch. Its stochastic masks therefore remain active in the inspected evaluation graph. Other architecture test paths were not read.
author_feature_sharing.operation: Elementwise masked sum of all member feature tensors; selfmask1, peer mask floor(.7+Uniform[0,1)), so Bernoulli(.7).

author_top1: src/model.py201 takes argmax(sum_member softmax); equivalent to argmax(unweighted mean). It does not expose a normalized probability output there; our probability metrics require the actual mean.
exact_table_winning_beta_K_by_dataset_mo: UNKNOWN in bounded paper/supplement/current author-code read; no claim defaults reproduce table winners.
